messages.text:
The preview button is visible and clickable in the accessibility snapshot, but React state is not changing reliably from that desktop/mobile overlay click.

I’m making the preview open on pointer-down as well as click, which is appropriate for a hover overlay control and removes the fragile dependence on post-hover click ordering.
